answer: A farm of 226 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are entered in quartz, queued in juniper, and atlas publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 90 identities per epoch. A farm of 4593 identities would post 4961 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
